messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a user in Prod tenant-A still has org-admin after last night's LDAP attribute migration. Deprov pipeline ran and SCIM logs show 200 for PATCH, but access remains. :eyes:
tyler: Do we have the sync logs? Which SCIM endpoint returned 200? Could be cache or role-mapping mismatch.
maria: Pasted the relevant provisioner snippet:```[2026-03-19T03:11:58Z] INFO delta_token updated=dt_2026_0319_031158
[2026-03-19T03:12:05Z] ERROR list-groups failed status=401 body="invalid token"
[2026-03-19T03:12:07Z] INFO PATCH /Users/abc123 returned 200
config: role_map: {"team":"org_admin"} // mapping changed memberOf->groups during migration```
samir: Hypothesis: IDP migration changed the attribute we use to derive roles. Deprov removed group membership in the IDP, but our RBAC mapping looks at extId/gid and the extId changed, so we never revoked the derived role. Also saw a token rotation at ~03:10 — service account creds rotated which likely caused the 401 on list-groups.
irene: Confirmed: KMS/Vault rotated SCIM client secret at 03:10 as part of rolling rotation. The provisioner caches credentials for 30m; when the upstream token became invalid we get 401 for list but the error handler currently treats list errors as non-fatal and continues, which allowed PATCHs to be attempted (and logged as 200) against stale data. We need fail-fast.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1382 scim-provisioner-deprov-drift (priority=P2)
tyler: Immediate remediation plan: 1) run an ad-hoc full reconcile against tenant-A: ./ops/scim_reconcile.sh --org tenant-A --force --fix (dry-run first) 2) rotate scim service token with infra in maintenance window if we see persistent 401s
samir: Quick script for targeted fix:```bash python scripts/scim_reconcile.py --mode=fix --org=tenant-A --limit=1000 --auth=manual```
maria: Ran dry-run -> 12 mismatches found. Ran fix -> 12 role removals applied. Confirmed the user lost org-admin. :thumbsup:
irene: Follow-ups (action items):
- scim-provisioner: make list-groups 401/5xx fail the entire sync (fail-fast)
- infra: reduce SCIM credential cache TTL from 30m -> 5m and add explicit token-refresh hook
- security: emit audit event "scim_sync_token_mismatch" when a 401 occurs so we can correlate with KMS rotations
- tests: add idempotent deprovisioning unit test (simulate extId/attribute rename)
tyler: Also add weekly reconciliation cron for high-risk orgs and a one-time backfill for last 7 days using audit logs to find orgs with mismatches.
maria: I'm opening PRs now: infra #2934 reduce cache TTL, scim-provisioner #1148 fail-fast on list errors, ops #67 add reconcile job.
samir: Adding runbook note: if reconcile fails or more than 100 mismatches are detected, escalate to eng-infra and consider a coordinated KMS key rewrap during a planned window.
maria: Thanks all — fixes applied in tenant-A, monitoring for 24h. Will post a short postmortem once PRs merge. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
